sheets.title: Documentation
values: Select which ASLs and what market you want in cells D5 and D6.
The tool cleans the data, replaces commas with dots and creates the correct columns
Removes all commas and replaces them with dots to avoid issues with csv exports later on
It exports the "RackfileUPLOAD" tab into a csv and saves this in a Google Drive folder. The link to the save folder will open.

This sheet takes all of the ingredients in the picklist and calculates the estimated usage per hour of production (measured in crates). Then the supermarket locations and the flowracks are added to create lists for the replenishers. The then know: 
- What to replace
- How much to replace it with
- When to replace
- Where to find the SKU
- Where to put the SKU

Total Picks: How often that recipe is picked on a specific day times the number of picks of that SKU for that recipe.

Units per case: the number of units there in a specific case (the base unit for replenishment).

Picks % of total mealkits: Total picks of the SKU / the total number of recipes to be picked for that portion size. Basically avg. number of picks of that SKU for a random recipe.

Hourly need: Previous metric times the boxes per hour (constant 400) and an average of 3.2 recipes per box. Units needed per hour.

Cases to pick: How many cases are needed per hour. Hourly need / units per case

Supermarket spot: Where to find it in the supermarket

Rack: Where to put the SKU in the rack
